description: Installs and starts Boss Scheduler (boss-sched), the always-on job scheduler that keeps running when BOSS is closed, and shows its jobs and run history. The scheduler itself runs under launchd (macOS) or systemd (Linux), not inside BOSS.
author: Risa Labs

definedPermissions.name: scheduler.manage
definedPermissions.description: Let agents run, enable and disable Boss Scheduler jobs. A run executes the job's command on this machine immediately.
